Club performance

Dead Nan Squad are just above break-even after 47 league games, with a skill rating of 1521.

The season splits in two. Over the first 37 games the club won 43% and conceded about two a match. In the last 10, all played on 10–11 October, the win rate halved and conceding rose by more than 1.5 goals a match. The attack scored just as freely, so the slump is a defensive one.

Only PUSB_1221 and xXLegitTurtle are registered in the squad, so the rest of the team, including the back line and goalkeeper, is AI-controlled. That explains why the pair can score 25 of the last 26 goals and still lose.

Recent form: last 10 league games

Form reads LLLLLWDLDW, but the trend is upward: after five straight defeats on Saturday, Sunday brought 2 wins, 2 draws and 1 loss.

  • Scoring was never the problem. The club scored in 9 of 10 games and found 3+ goals six times. The heaviest defeats (4-6 v HELL U9S, 4-7 v Daddys BoyZ) came on days the pair scored four.
  • Defending was. Conceded in every game, no clean sheets, 7 conceded v Daddys BoyZ.
  • Pressing doesn't win the ball back. The two players won 12 of 106 tackle attempts (11%), so the AI defence faces wave after wave.
  • Ball retention is fine. 503 of 634 passes completed (79%) and 25 goals from 74 shots (34%).

Tactics: the 4-4-2 Flat

The same custom tactic has been used in all 47 games. Both human players play up front, so the roles given to the nine AI teammates decide how the team defends.

The game's own analysis already points at the problem the results show: "Defence easy to overload".

How the tactic shapes results

The setup is built to attack and leaves the back four short of cover. The scoring and conceding numbers line up with that design.

FC 27 makes the defensive side worse. EA's FC 27 gameplay deep dive says AI defenders now "rely more on their positioning and support the play until you take control". In normal matches you switch to the defender to win the ball. In Clubs nobody controls your back line, so the AI defenders hold position and wait, and attacks keep coming. EA says these AI changes apply to Competitive gameplay, which this assumes covers your Clubs league games.

Pros and cons of each setting

The attacking half of the tactic works. The trouble is the two central midfielders and the defensive approach, which together leave the AI back four exposed.

What the FC 27 guides say:

  • Formations. None of the main guides list 4-4-2 Flat among the best formations. LiquidFC calls it a balanced "starter formation" and rates 4-1-2-1-2(2) the most meta at launch, because it "controls midfield". Dexerto's recommended setups all include a Holding midfielder on Defend.
  • Defensive approach. Per FIFA UTeam, Deep (line 1–30) drops back with runners, Balanced (31–60) is flexible, High (61–90) rarely tracks runs and Aggressive (91–100) presses after losing the ball, at a stamina cost.
  • Build-up. Short Passing keeps the defensive shape longer in transition. Counter sends players forward quickly. Balanced sits in between.
  • Roles. FIFPlay describes Holding as "shields the defence and protects central areas" and Box-to-Box as contributing "in both attack and defence".

Suggested changes

The aim is to protect the AI back four without blunting an attack that already scores 2.57 a match. Option A is the quickest fix; Option B is the bigger reset towards what the FC 27 guides rate as meta.

Setting Now Option A: fix the 4-4-2 Option B: 4-1-2-1-2 (2)
Formation 4-4-2 Flat Keep 4-1-2-1-2 (2)
Build-up style Balanced Short Passing Short Passing
Defensive approach Balanced Deep, line about 25–30 Balanced, line about 40
Central midfield Box-to-Box · Balanced ×2 Holding · Defend + Box-to-Box · Balanced CDM Holding · Defend + Box-to-Box · Balanced and Ball Winning
Wide midfield Winger · Balanced ×2 Wide Midfielder · Balanced (LM), Winger · Balanced (RM) No wide mids
Full-backs Fullback · Balanced ×2 Fullback · Defend ×2 Fullback · Defend ×2
CBs and keeper Defender · Defend, Goalkeeper · Defend Keep Keep
xXLegitTurtle ST ST, dropping deep to link CAM, the creator role his 61 assists suit
Second striker Human Human AI Target Forward · Attack beside PUSB_1221

Why these changes:

  • A Holding midfielder screens the centre, directly answering "defence easy to overload". Every recommended FC 27 setup in the guides has one.
  • Full-backs on Defend stop both flanks emptying at once, so a turnover no longer leaves two CBs alone.
  • Short Passing keeps players behind the ball for longer in transition, which protects the back line. The front two still make the runs.
  • A deeper line in Option A gives the AI defenders less space to cover behind them. Because they no longer step in to tackle, less space is the best protection.
  • Turtle at CAM in Option B puts the squad's best passer (29.3 passes a match, 61 assists) in the playmaker spot. PUSB_1221 stays as the finisher.

Player profiles

Both are listed as strikers and have played every one of the club's 47 league matches, but PUSB_1221 carries the higher overall while xXLegitTurtle earns the higher match ratings.

The form score is ProClubsHead's summary rating of each player's last 10 league matches.

Season head-to-head (47 league matches)

xXLegitTurtle wins most of the head-to-head stats, but PUSB_1221 wins the one strikers are judged on: goals. Neither player has a red card or a defensive clean sheet.

Attack: finisher vs creator

PUSB_1221 scores almost twice as often (1.53 vs 0.81 goals per match), but xXLegitTurtle sets up more than 2.5 times as many (1.30 vs 0.49 assists per match), so their total output is level.

  • Shooting volume. PUSB_1221 is the designated shooter. In the last 10 league games he took 55 shots to xXLegitTurtle's 19 (5.5 vs 1.9 per match). Across the season his 72 goals at a 30% success rate imply roughly 240 shots, against roughly 105 for xXLegitTurtle (estimated from goals ÷ shot success rate).
  • Efficiency. xXLegitTurtle converts better: 36% for the season and 42% over the last 10, against 30% and 31% for PUSB_1221. He shoots rarely but picks his moments.
  • Creativity. xXLegitTurtle's 61 assists are the squad's main supply line, and very likely the main source of PUSB_1221's 72 goals — though ProClubsHead doesn't record who assisted whom.
  • Total involvement. 99 goal involvements to 95 in xXLegitTurtle's favour; per match 2.11 vs 2.02. Over the last 10 the order flips: PUSB_1221 24 (2.40 per match), xXLegitTurtle 22 (2.20).

Team play and defence

xXLegitTurtle is the squad's engine: he makes 29.3 passes and 1.0 tackles per match, close to double PUSB_1221's 17.4 and 0.5.

  • Passing. xXLegitTurtle drops deep and recycles the ball, with 1,378 completed passes to 819. Accuracy is near-identical (76% vs 78%); over the last 10 both sit at 79%, so the volume gap isn't costing him precision.
  • Pressing and tackling. Tackling is the weakest area for both. PUSB_1221 wins only 8% of attempts (4 from 59 over the last 10); xXLegitTurtle wins 22% for the season and 17% recently (8 from 47).
  • Discipline. Neither has a red card in 47 matches.
  • Team defence. No defensive clean sheets for either player, and the club conceded 36 goals in the last 10 league games (3.6 a match). Two strikers can't fix that alone, but it is the club's biggest problem.

Last 10 league matches

The club went 2 wins, 2 draws and 6 losses, but form is turning: all five early games were lost, then 2-2-1 in the latest five.

PUSB_1221 did his damage in the middle run (hat-tricks in the 4-6 and 4-7 defeats, four in the 5-5 draw); xXLegitTurtle took over in the latest two, winning man of the match in both. The pair scored 3, 4 and 4 goals in three defeats — the losses came at the other end.

Both hit 10.0 in the 4-6 defeat and the 5-5 draw, and each took 3 man-of-the-match awards in the run.

Verdict

Dead Nan Squad have an attack good enough to win most games. The defence is costing them, and the last 10 games show it plainly.

The club

Club priorities

  • Recruit a third human player, ideally a centre-back or goalkeeper
  • Have xXLegitTurtle, already the busiest passer, sit deeper when protecting a lead
  • Contain rather than lunge: 106 tackle attempts for 12 wins leaves gaps behind
  • Track goals conceded per match as the headline number for the next 10 games

The players

Who's better? On involvement per match, xXLegitTurtle edges it (2.11 vs 2.02) over the season; over the last 10 PUSB_1221 does (2.40 vs 2.20). Effectively a draw.
